content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can become expensive, slow, and less reliable when context grows. This skill guides compaction, masking, caching, and partitioning to preserve useful context.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to compact long conversation history near context limits.
Describes observation masking for reducing verbose tool output in active context.
Shows cache-friendly ordering for stable prompts, tools, and reused templates.
Provides context budget guidance for system prompts, tools, documents, history, and buffer space.
Recommends partitioning complex work across focused sub-agent contexts.
limitations: Provides guidance only; it does not include executable optimization tooling.
Does not guarantee quality preservation after aggressive summarization.
Requires measurement in the target model, workload, and application environment.
Does not replace provider-specific documentation for cache pricing or behavior.

use_cases.title: Control Long Agent Sessions
use_cases.description: Apply compaction and masking when an agent accumulates large histories or verbose tool outputs.

use_cases.title: Reduce Inference Cost
use_cases.description: Design prompts and context ordering that improve cache reuse and reduce repeated token processing.

use_cases.title: Plan Scalable Context Workflows
use_cases.description: Split complex work across focused contexts and aggregate results without overloading one session.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Optimization Method
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage for a growing context window.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current AI workflow and recommend whether to use compaction, observation masking, cache-friendly ordering, or partitioning. Explain the first step.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Context Budget
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a repeatable agent workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a context budget for this workflow. Allocate space for system instructions, tools, retrieved documents, conversation history, and a reserved buffer.

prompt_templates.title: Design Masking Rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate optimization for verbose tool outputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create observation masking rules for this agent. Identify which outputs to keep, summarize, replace with references, or never mask.

prompt_templates.title: Architect Partitioned Contexts
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced design for multi-agent or large-document systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a partitioned context strategy for this complex task. Define sub-agent scopes, handoff summaries, aggregation rules, and quality checks.

output_examples.input: A coding agent keeps full terminal logs and long files in context during a multi-hour task.
output_examples.output: Recommended approach: summarize older terminal logs, mask repeated boilerplate, keep current errors visible, and preserve final decisions in a compact task state.

output_examples.input: A support assistant repeats the same policy and tool definitions across many requests.
output_examples.output: Recommended approach: place stable instructions first, keep policy text consistent, move unique customer details later, and monitor cache hit rate.

output_examples.input: A research workflow must analyze many documents without losing source coverage.
output_examples.output: Recommended approach: partition documents into focused batches, summarize each batch with citations, then aggregate only validated findings into the main context.

best_practices: Measure token usage, cost, latency, and quality before changing context strategy.
Preserve recent, task-critical, and decision-supporting information before compressing older material.
Keep stable prompt sections first so cacheable prefixes remain consistent across requests.
anti_patterns: Do not compact system instructions or safety-critical requirements.
Do not mask observations that are still needed for active reasoning or verification.
Do not optimize for token reduction without checking response quality and task accuracy.

faq.question: Does this skill run any optimization code?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for designing context optimization strategies.

faq.question: Can it increase a model context window?
faq.answer: No. It helps use the existing context window more efficiently.

faq.question: When should I use compaction?
faq.answer: Use compaction when context usage is high and older information can be summarized without losing key decisions.

faq.question: What is observation masking?
faq.answer: Observation masking replaces verbose tool output with a compact reference and a short summary.

faq.question: How does this help Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: It gives prompt and workflow patterns for long sessions in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I measure after applying it?
faq.answer: Measure token reduction, latency, cost, cache hit rate, and task quality.
